legacy_comparison_role: Diagnostic only: historical float32 preprocessing and drug-ID folds differ from this protocol

scope.secondary: GDSC to PRISM, strict chemical mapping; published and shared-window AUC
scope.experimental: Other architectures, endpoint interpretations and historical runs

config.legacy_reference_defined_at: Float32 and drug-ID-disjoint checkpoint; different numerical recipe and partitions

environment.gpu_driver_memory: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 591.66, 8188 MiB

chemistry.note: Aliases remain as measured records but cannot cross cold-drug subsets.

notes: Common endpoint definition; exposure duration remains study-specific/unknown in these inputs.
No extrapolation outside measured dose support. Fits use all measured doses.
Eligibility requires strict chemical mapping, existing cohort pairs and dose coverage.
Exploratory reuse of an already examined external screen, not new confirmatory validation.

limits: Exploratory research; PRISM has already been examined.
Overlapping CV training folds are not independent studies.
Entity bootstrap is conditional on fitted models, not training uncertainty.
Frozen ChemBERTa features are verified inputs, not regenerated encoder weights.
Shared dose window does not equate exposure time or assay biology.
Published and harmonized AUC differ in definition; compare against B0 within each endpoint.
Coverage failure in PRISM remains a valid negative result.
